title: 8 Rooms Where a Godly Man Doesn't Switch Faces
caption:
8 rooms where a godly man doesn't switch faces.

Not even the one nobody's checking.

Above all else, guard your heart, for everything you do flows from it (Proverbs 4:23). The rooms on this list are the ones nobody's grading. That's exactly why they're the ones that matter most.

The group chat when she's not in it. The car alone at a red light. The prayer he says out loud in front of the guys. Same guy, every room.

#faith #christianmen #manofgod #integrity #character #discipleship
